description: This file is a shell script configuring WireGuard VPN interfaces on OpenWRT. It defines functions for initializing, setting up, renewing, and tearing down WireGuard configurations, including key management and peer configuration.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the WireGuard protocol configuration with default parameters.

methods.name: ensure_key_is_generated
methods.description: Ensures a private key exists for the interface, generating and saving it if necessary.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_setup
methods.description: Sets up the WireGuard interface with addresses, peers, and configuration, applying it via wg.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the WireGuard interface, deleting the device.
